errors.generic: Nothing was written — try again, or check the model settings for this workspace.
errors.not_indexed: The extractor samples the repo's highest-ranked files, and that ranking comes from the index. Index the repo, then scan again.
errors.not_cloned: The repo has to finish cloning before its files can be sampled.

errors.noneSurvivedBody: Every candidate cited a file or a line the sample did not contain, so all of them were dropped. Re-scanning may do better; a repeat of this usually means the model needs a larger sample.
